parsed.reason: Both descriptions identify the same root cause: on a denied request, bucket.tokens is updated with the refill but bucket.updated_at is not advanced, so the next check re-adds the same elapsed interval and over-grants tokens, letting the effective rate exceed the limit. Description A adds a concrete example, while Description B additionally mentions the wrong retry_after hint, but the defect and location match.
